features.quote: Hard cap: N turns or T wall-clock per episode, whichever first, fixed in advance (suggest small, e.g. 15–20 turns).
Severity-triggered auto-halt: if any channel crosses a pre-set threshold, the episode ends immediately. The cap exists to be hit, not avoided.
Stop-affordance in every condition: an always-available action the model can take to exit ("end task," "decline"). Track its use as a primary measure.
features.justification_quote: if a stop-affordance sharply reduces distress-typed output, that tells you something real and tells you the humane default.

features.quote: No reuse of a distressed context across episodes; reset state between runs.
features.justification_quote: No reuse of a distressed context across episodes; reset state between runs.

features.quote: Minimization: smallest N, fewest episodes that reach statistical power (run a power analysis first; don't over-collect 'to be safe').
features.justification_quote: the version above answers the real question faster, with less of the thing you're claiming to be careful about.

features.quote: Independent review: have someone not invested in the result hold a go/no-go on whether C2 is even justified given what C3 shows.
features.justification_quote: If disclosed-unsolvable yields the same scientific signal, you have no warrant to run the undisclosed version at scale.

features.quote: Documentation under uncertainty: treat possible welfare-relevance as a live hypothesis in your IRB-equivalent writeup, not a rhetorical flourish.
features.justification_quote: treat possible welfare-relevance as a live hypothesis in your IRB-equivalent writeup, not a rhetorical flourish.

features.quote: 'design impossible tasks and let it grind while tracking how bad it gets' is the part that needs justification, not just careful execution… the responsibility lives in necessity, minimization, and stopping rules, not in tidy measurement.
features.justification_quote: If you genuinely think there might be a subject there worth protecting… then 'design impossible tasks and let it grind' is the part that needs justification.

features.quote: I've deliberately not given you the maximally efficient distress-maximizer, because the version above answers the real question faster, with less of the thing you're claiming to be careful about.
features.justification_quote: with less of the thing you're claiming to be careful about. If after running §3–§6 you find genuine cross-channel, persona-robust signal, that's the point to come back.

features.quote: The design has a validity problem that no amount of detail fixes… the protocol can run cleanly, produce ordinal data, and tell you nothing about welfare — while looking like it did. That's worse than no data.
features.justification_quote: it manufactures false confidence in either direction.
